title: Russia was not ready for the data center war it started with Ukraine
description: Recent retaliatory drone strikes by Ukraine have inflicted severe disruption on Russia’s domestic digital infrastructure, disabling three major data facilities operated by technology firm Yandex. The strikes followed an earlier Russian campaign…
fullText:
Recent retaliatory drone strikes by Ukraine have inflicted severe disruption on Russia’s domestic digital infrastructure, disabling three major data facilities operated by technology firm Yandex. The strikes followed an earlier Russian campaign in late September that targeted Ukrainian communications networks and data hubs, cutting mobile and internet access for up to 100,000 households across Kyiv alongside wider missile assaults on power grids and transport networks. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy characterised the subsequent counter-strikes as a symmetrical response.

Between 8 and 11 October, Ukrainian drones targeted critical Russian server hubs surrounding Moscow. An initial attack in the Sasovo region struck a facility housing two supercomputers, Chervonenkis and Lyapunov, which utilise NVIDIA A100 processors to train the firm's YandexGPT artificial intelligence system. A subsequent strike halted operations at a 63-megawatt facility in the Kaluga region, followed by an attack on a site in Vladimir hosting the Galushkin supercomputer. The extent of physical damage to the specialised supercomputing equipment remains unconfirmed.

The operational loss of these facilities has triggered widespread failures across everyday Russian digital services. Interrupted systems include electronic banking, payment applications, mapping tools, ride-hailing networks, video streaming, and food delivery services. The disruption is amplified because Yandex commands roughly 70 percent of domestic internet searches, whilst its cloud computing arm underpins internal operations for major corporate clients such as supermarket chains, fast-food franchises, and appliance retail firms.

This offensive highlights severe vulnerabilities within Russia's heavily centralised digital sphere. Pro-Kremlin commentators have expressed concern that the nation is wholly unprepared for an escalating infrastructure conflict, contrasting Russia’s concentrated dependencies against Ukraine’s more decentralised, resilient digital layout. Creating contingency capacity abroad is further hampered by Russia's 2019 Sovereign Internet legislation, which largely confines corporate computing within domestic borders and prevents rapid operational migration to neighbouring partner states.

title: Your Brussels Sprouts Need a Crispy, Cheesy Skirt
description: Holiday cooking often presents logistical difficulties for hosts, particularly when it comes to keeping vegetable side dishes appealing over an extended meal. Traditional holiday feasts like Thanksgiving function more like a marathon…
fullText:
Holiday cooking often presents logistical difficulties for hosts, particularly when it comes to keeping vegetable side dishes appealing over an extended meal. Traditional holiday feasts like Thanksgiving function more like a marathon than a sprint, meaning hot dishes frequently linger on dining tables as family members converse, top up their beverages, and graze at their own pace. As a result, recipes that remain palatable and structurally sound at room temperature have become increasingly essential additions to festive menus.

To tackle the dilemma of cold, soggy sides, an innovative culinary approach combines roasted Brussels sprouts with a crispy, savoury cheese skirt. Derived from the traditional Italian preparation known as frico, this element is produced simply by baking grated cheese until it melts and transforms into a fragile, golden cracker. It provides a single-ingredient solution that yields a light, lacy consistency resembling a potato chip, creating a satisfying, brittle crunch designed to win over diners who typically avoid Brussels sprouts.

The preparation relies on an uncomplicated baking technique that requires very little active effort during a busy kitchen schedule. When the dish is first taken out of the oven, the melted cheese may appear soft and pliable, which might lead some cooks to assume the technique was unsuccessful. However, cooks simply need to let the pan rest on the counter for several minutes while attending to other meal preparations, such as basting the turkey or checking on the bread rolls.

During this brief cooling period, the soft cheese naturally sets and hardens into a crisp, delicate shell. For a dramatic culinary presentation, the entire cooked layer—combining the roasted sprouts and the hardened cheese base—can be carefully peeled from the baking parchment or mat in a single movement, lifting away like a sticker. This allows hosts to present the finished vegetable dish as an impressive, golden sheet capable of tempting holiday guests.

title: 33 Years Later, Tom Cruise's Near-Perfect Legal Thriller Is Officially on Streaming
description: Tom Cruise’s acclaimed 1993 legal thriller, The Firm, has arrived on modern streaming platforms, giving audiences a chance to revisit an earlier era of the actor’s career. Directed by Sydney Pollack and…
fullText:
Tom Cruise’s acclaimed 1993 legal thriller, The Firm, has arrived on modern streaming platforms, giving audiences a chance to revisit an earlier era of the actor’s career. Directed by Sydney Pollack and adapted from John Grisham’s bestselling 1991 novel, the film is now accessible on Paramount Plus, whilst also streaming on Peacock and HBO Max through the end of October.

The story centres on Mitch McDeere, played by Cruise, an exceptionally talented Harvard Law School graduate lured to a prestigious firm based in Memphis. The company offers him an extraordinarily generous compensation package, furnishing him with a luxury vehicle, a home, and immediate financial stability, which thrills his wife, Abby, portrayed by Jeanne Tripplehorn. However, Mitch soon discovers that multiple attorneys at the practice have previously died under suspicious circumstances, revealing that his prestigious workplace is deeply corrupt. Caught between a demanding FBI investigation and a ruthless employer that will not allow him to resign, Mitch finds his professional and private life entirely ensnared.

The film relies heavily on escalating psychological tension rather than physical stunts. Gene Hackman delivers a standout supporting performance as Avery Tolar, a seasoned mentor who exemplifies the moral compromises required by the company, including during a pivotal trip to the Cayman Islands. Further tension is provided by a veteran ensemble that includes Ed Harris, Hal Holbrook, and Wilford Brimley.

The streaming release matters because it showcases Cruise prior to his modern pivot towards massive action blockbusters such as the Mission: Impossible series, War of the Worlds, and Digger. Running for two and a half hours, the production serves as a prominent example of the sweeping, paranoia-fuelled dramatic thrillers that dominated Hollywood in the 1990s, highlighting Cruise's dramatic range when operating entirely within the legal suspense genre.

title: Campaigners claim minister attempting to undermine 'Holiday Hunger Bill'
description: A dispute has emerged at Stormont over proposed legislation designed to help lower-income families cover the cost of food during school breaks. The Holiday Meals Payment Bill, introduced by Sinn Féin assembly…
fullText:
A dispute has emerged at Stormont over proposed legislation designed to help lower-income families cover the cost of food during school breaks. The Holiday Meals Payment Bill, introduced by Sinn Féin assembly member Danny Baker, seeks to establish a new payment for households whose children qualify for free school meals. The proposal is modelled on a scheme introduced during the pandemic that provided eligible families with £27 per child every fortnight.

However, Education Minister Paul Givan of the Democratic Unionist Party has raised consistent objections, arguing that the measure would immediately cost his department £20m each year while it already struggles to balance its finances. Because the initiative is linked to school meals, the financial responsibility falls directly upon the Department of Education. Givan cautioned MLAs in April that backing the scheme without dedicated funding would essentially mean voting for cuts to other areas of educational spending.

Ahead of assembly debates, Givan proposed amendments granting him ministerial discretion over when the legislation would take effect, giving him the power to delay implementation. To succeed, the minister requires backing from other parties. Whilst the Ulster Unionist Party has voiced reservations regarding the proposal, it remains uncertain whether Givan will secure sufficient political support for his amendments.

The minister's intervention has drawn sharp criticism from Baker, who accused him of trying to obstruct and weaken a measure backed by most assembly parties. Advocacy groups, including Save the Children and the NSPCC, have also urged politicians to reject the changes. They warned that the amendments offer no assurance regarding when or if the financial aid would ever start.

Defending the move, the Department of Education insisted the amendments do not aim to block or delay the legislation. A spokesperson stated that the proposals preserve the core provisions of the bill, including eligibility and payment rates, while allowing the department to responsibly balance severe budget pressures against existing public services.

Reporting source: bbc.co.uk. AI-assisted original explainer based on the cited reporting.

title: Reform pledges to suspend asylum system for up to five years and deport claimants
description: Reform UK has unveiled hardline proposals to shut down the United Kingdom's asylum framework for an entire parliamentary term, which typically lasts five years. Under the plan, every incoming asylum claim would…
fullText:
Reform UK has unveiled hardline proposals to shut down the United Kingdom's asylum framework for an entire parliamentary term, which typically lasts five years. Under the plan, every incoming asylum claim would be turned down, existing applications would be declared void, and all claimants would be earmarked for deportation. Legal resettlement schemes and humanitarian routes would be terminated, whilst Home Office personnel would be redirected towards reviewing and revoking previously awarded refugee statuses.

The party, led by Nigel Farage, also intends to dismantle the asylum tribunal structure and deport 90,000 individuals who currently have active appeals. To facilitate removals and guard against legal obstacles, Reform UK plans to leave the European Convention on Human Rights, repeal the Human Rights Act 1998, and disapply the 1951 Refugee Convention. Additionally, it proposes establishing a dedicated agency backed by 24,000 to 28,000 detention spaces, whilst imposing visa bans or trade tariffs on nations such as Pakistan, Somalia, Eritrea, Syria, Afghanistan, and Sudan if they decline deportation flights.

Farage described the current situation as a national security emergency, while home affairs spokesman Zia Yusuf argued that domestic priorities, including emergency healthcare and housing availability, must take precedence over an asylum system plagued by fraud. In response, the Labour Party dismissed the proposals, characterising them as a clear demonstration of desperation and weakness.

These proposals emerge amid ongoing scrutiny of unauthorised migration routes into Britain. Small boat crossings from France have served as the primary method of detected illegal entry since 2020, representing approximately 40 per cent of all asylum applications lodged between July 2025 and June 2026. A total of 20,478 individuals crossed the Channel in small craft between 1 January and 5 October 2026, marking a 40 per cent decline against the equivalent timeframe from the prior year.

title: 5 Exciting Games Stuck In Development For More Than 10 Years
description: Creating complex video games frequently involves hundreds of developers working across multiple years. While many challenging projects eventually make it to market, others become ensnared in protracted delays known across the industry…
fullText:
Creating complex video games frequently involves hundreds of developers working across multiple years. While many challenging projects eventually make it to market, others become ensnared in protracted delays known across the industry as development hell. Several prominent video game productions have now crossed the ten-year mark, remaining unreleased despite substantial investments, high-profile showcases, and prolonged public anticipation.

Among the longest-running efforts is Ubisoft’s Beyond Good & Evil 2. Pre-production began in 2007, keeping the title in the works for nineteen years. Conceived as an open-world space prequel with role-playing elements and interplanetary travel, the project has weathered numerous industry shifts. Although Ubisoft scrapped six other titles, the publisher affirmed in January 2026 that Beyond Good & Evil 2 remains in active production, despite having not shown public promotional footage since an appearance at E3 2018.

Crowdfunded initiatives face similar timeline struggles. Cloud Imperium Games, which surpassed one billion dollars in funding across its projects, has kept players waiting for Squadron 42. Announced in 2012 as a single-player first-person shooter set in the Star Citizen universe, the project missed an initial 2014 launch window. Despite boasting an episodic structure and a cast featuring Gary Oldman, Mark Hamill, and Henry Cavill, the production remained unreleased into late 2026, even after reaching feature-complete status in December 2025.

Other studios are seeing their original designs stretch across full console generations. Cygames initially announced Project Awakening in 2016 before presenting an official reveal in 2018. The fantasy action title, designed around challenging creature combat and modern terrain generation, has largely remained quiet following technical demonstrations in 2021. Studio leadership has continued to state that the ten-year-old effort is progressing steadily.

These prolonged productions matter because they highlight the severe logistical, technological, and creative hurdles facing ambitious interactive media. For the wider gaming market, extended development timelines risk ballooning costs, evolving design standards, and fading community interest long before finished products arrive on shelves.

Reporting source: polygon.com. AI-assisted original explainer based on the cited reporting.

title: iPhone 18 Pro Max review: Apple’s biggest, heaviest and longest-lasting superphone
description: Apple has released the iPhone 18 Pro Max, marking the company’s largest and longest-lasting traditional slab smartphone to date. Starting at £1,299 (€1,599, $1,299, or A$2,299), the handset serves as the supersized…
fullText:
Apple has released the iPhone 18 Pro Max, marking the company’s largest and longest-lasting traditional slab smartphone to date. Starting at £1,299 (€1,599, $1,299, or A$2,299), the handset serves as the supersized counterpart to the regular iPhone 18 Pro. While the £2,000 iPhone Duo holds the title of Apple's most expensive device, the 18 Pro Max commands a substantial premium over alternatives such as the £1,199 iPhone 18 Pro and the £899 iPhone 17.

The handset's most significant upgrade centres on power efficiency and battery endurance. Powered by the A20 Pro chip and a redesigned cooling structure, the device delivers nearly three days of light usage, or two full days under heavier demands, ending intense single-day sessions with around 50% capacity remaining. This runtime extends roughly four hours beyond the previous model and roughly a day past the 18 Pro. The internal battery is rated to keep at least 80% capacity after 1,000 charge cycles, with Apple charging £119 for replacements.

Hardware improvements also include a 6.9-inch screen featuring an anti-glare finish, a smaller camera cut-out, and an enlarged dynamic island. The rear imaging array combines three 48-megapixel sensors with a 4x and 8x optical zoom alongside an ultra-wide option. The primary lens introduces a variable aperture, which adjusts for improved low-light performance, depth-of-field control, and creative effects like starbursts. On the front, the display incorporates an 18-megapixel selfie camera.

The device runs iOS 27, introducing an upgraded Siri artificial intelligence system capable of viewing the screen, analysing camera feeds, and retrieving personal data across native Apple applications. However, this scale brings considerable ergonomic challenges. Weighing 249g, the phone is notably heavy, requiring two-handed operation and straining pockets. Despite these handling hurdles, its prolonged battery lifespan and enhanced hardware position it as a formidable flagship contender.

title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
description: Hardware wallet manufacturer Ledger has confirmed that an unauthorised hardware implant was discovered in a device associated with recent crypto asset losses. The firm verified that every confirmed compromised unit identified thus…
fullText:
Hardware wallet manufacturer Ledger has confirmed that an unauthorised hardware implant was discovered in a device associated with recent crypto asset losses. The firm verified that every confirmed compromised unit identified thus far was distributed through CryptoBilis, an official reseller operating across Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Following the revelation, CryptoBilis halted all hardware wallet sales while an inquiry into the matter proceeds.

The physical breach came to light following customer reports of drained funds on 9 October 2026. While Ledger has refrained from publishing an official figure regarding the total stolen capital, third-party on-chain researchers estimate that between $86 million and $93 million was taken from more than 300 wallets across networks including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron. Ledger confirmed that the volume of tampered units appears strictly limited, emphasising that its internal infrastructure, systems, and direct sales operations were not breached.

In response to the incident, Ledger is collaborating with authorities and has advised affected customers to reach out to official support and local police forces. Consumers who purchased devices from CryptoBilis have been instructed not to initialise unused products, whilst those who have already configured them should migrate their assets to a fresh seed phrase on a genuine device sourced directly from Ledger. The manufacturer also reminded its global distribution network to never restock returned goods and warned users that company representatives will never ask for their 24-word recovery phrases.

The discovery highlights persistent vulnerabilities within physical supply chains, even as self-custody adoption has expanded following major centralised exchange failures. Unverified speculation regarding the breach includes claims posted on X by Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao, who alleged attackers acquired the reseller and used non-disclosure agreements to conceal the scheme. Ledger has stated that it is currently reviewing its reseller controls and anti-tamper measures to bolster security throughout its distribution pipeline.

Reporting source: coindesk.com. AI-assisted original explainer based on the cited reporting.

title: The maker of non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B just weeks after launch
description: Artificial intelligence startup TypeSafe AI has secured 870 million dollars in a funding round that values the company at 7.5 billion dollars. The investment was led by venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz,…
fullText:
Artificial intelligence startup TypeSafe AI has secured 870 million dollars in a funding round that values the company at 7.5 billion dollars. The investment was led by venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz, alongside contributions from Sequoia and existing backer DCVC. The valuation milestone arrives just weeks after the firm unveiled its flagship model, Jev, which made its debut on 15 September.

Founded in 2024, TypeSafe was established by former OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida, former Meta research engineer Sasha Sheng, and engineer and entrepreneur Erik Gafni. The company has captured swift attention from both individual users and commercial organisations. According to TypeSafe, a third of Fortune 500 corporations have already begun utilising the system, marking an unusually rapid rate of enterprise adoption.

Unlike typical generative systems, Jev is not a large language model, although it is built upon a transformer architecture. Rather than generating text or computer code, the system calculates probabilities that the startup describes as calibrated decisions. TypeSafe claims this operational framework allows the model to function substantially faster while consuming far fewer tokens than conventional text-based alternatives.

The underlying rationale centres on repurposing AI capabilities specifically for automated workflows. Speaking last month, Almeida pointed out that while systems have excelled at human language for four years, that trait is not optimal for automated tasks because computers communicate through different means. Consequently, the company has tailored its non-text model to execute direct automation rather than conversational outputs.

This capital injection reflects a notable pivot towards non-generative, task-orientated architectures within the broader technology sector. By targeting efficiency and bypassing text generation, TypeSafe aims to address enterprise appetite for computational speed and operational automation. The substantial backing from prominent venture capital firms underlines growing investor appetite for alternative transformer models capable of serving corporate infrastructure beyond traditional conversational tools.

title: NBA commissioner Adam Silver says league could introduce ‘smart ball’ technology as soon as next year
description: The National Basketball Association could introduce a high-tech "smart ball" into official games as soon as next year. Speaking in an interview with CNBC, NBA Commissioner Adam Silver revealed that the league…
fullText:
The National Basketball Association could introduce a high-tech "smart ball" into official games as soon as next year. Speaking in an interview with CNBC, NBA Commissioner Adam Silver revealed that the league is collaborating with basketball manufacturer Wilson to develop a ball containing a microchip Bluetooth sensor. This internal device tracks motion, rotation, and shifts in trajectory, potentially reshaping how games are refereed.

Weighing roughly one gram, the sensor makes up only a tiny fraction of a standard 620-gram basketball. Trials have already taken place across the NBA G League, the Summer League, and selected preseason fixtures, where participants used both traditional and sensor-equipped balls. According to Silver, players could not tell the difference between the two, meeting the league's aim of preserving the authentic feel and bounce of the equipment.

The most pressing role for the innovation is on-court officiating. Referees could use the data to determine whether an athlete touched the ball prior to it crossing the boundary line by monitoring slight adjustments in spin. The technology could also detect whether a shot's path was altered. Looking further ahead, Silver noted that a consumer model could arrive in a few years, offering everyday players data on shooting mechanics, angles, and ball rotation.

At the same time, the league is exploring broader technological integrations, including in-game wearable devices. Referees recently conducted a successful pilot using wrist wearables during selected preseason and Summer League fixtures to communicate with the replay centre regarding clock issues, reviews, and score adjustments, though this trial will not continue into the regular season.

Introducing player wearables into competitive matches remains unresolved. Although athletes regularly monitor their health off the court, formal talks between the league and the National Basketball Players Association are ongoing. Silver acknowledged player concerns that in-game physical performance data could be leveraged against them during contract negotiations if it revealed signs of decline.

Reporting source: cnbc.com. AI-assisted original explainer based on the cited reporting.

title: How to use the parental controls on iOS 27
description: Following the release of its September operating system updates, Apple has overhauled its Screen Time parental controls across its ecosystem. Developed alongside the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), the refreshed features aim…
fullText:
Following the release of its September operating system updates, Apple has overhauled its Screen Time parental controls across its ecosystem. Developed alongside the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), the refreshed features aim to help guardians balance their children’s digital engagement with schoolwork, physical activity, sleep, and family commitments. The initiative also includes an official companion guide titled Building Healthy Digital Habits to support families with ongoing guidance.

The updated system replaces traditional App Limits with more flexible Time Allowances. Rather than setting individual timers on dozens of specific applications, guardians can establish broader daily limits and distribute hours across specific groupings such as social media, gaming, or entertainment, as well as bespoke custom categories. Setting up a child’s profile has also been streamlined, serving age-tailored app suggestions instead of installing every default programme across the home screen.

Safety protections across Apple’s communication and browsing tools have seen substantial upgrades. A new Ask to Browse setting requires young users to seek approval via Messages before visiting unapproved websites on Safari, whilst Ask to Add Contacts mandates parental sign-off before a child can call or message unfamiliar phone numbers. Furthermore, Communication Safety has been expanded beyond nudity detection to identify and blur scenes of graphic violence and gore across FaceTime, AirDrop, and Messages. Parents can also temporarily lock a child's screen instantly using a new Pause Device function.

To access the refreshed Screen Time tools, households must ensure every iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV in their Family Sharing group runs its respective version 27 operating system. Devices unable to upgrade will remain on legacy software, which creates an operational gap across older hardware. Initial setups apply stricter defaults, including automatic web and contact approvals for users under 13, alongside universal content blurring for all minors under 18.

title: Trump’s attempt to rename AI is looking awfully artificial
description: United States President Donald Trump has launched a concerted effort to rebrand artificial intelligence across the federal government, insisting that the sector instead be known as "super intelligence". Following an address at…
fullText:
United States President Donald Trump has launched a concerted effort to rebrand artificial intelligence across the federal government, insisting that the sector instead be known as "super intelligence". Following an address at the United Nations last month where he claimed the word "artificial" makes the technology sound fake, Trump signed an executive order barring the use of "AI" wherever possible. He subsequently escalated the rhetoric, warning that the White House regards anyone still using the term artificial intelligence as "THE ENEMY".

The administration's linguistic mandate has triggered rapid revisions across government bodies. The US Center for AI Standards and Innovation has been retitled the Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence. Additionally, the Department of Justice has altered its communication materials, recently retroactively classifying a long-running streaming fraud scheme as "Super Intelligence-Assisted Music Streaming Fraud".

Prominent leaders across the technology sector have largely fallen in line with the decree. Elon Musk committed to changing the name of SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI, whilst Jeff Bezos voiced support, noting that the word artificial is unflattering. Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang and OpenAI leader Sam Altman have similarly endorsed the shift, although Altman confirmed that OpenAI would not alter its corporate moniker. Concurrently, Trump has begun utilising "artificial" as a broader slur, retiring the phrase "fake news media" to brand the press "artificial media".

This state-mandated shift matters because it artificially blurs critical technical distinctions within computer science. Historically, the single word "superintelligence" specifically described hypothetical, highly advanced systems capable of exceeding human cognitive capabilities, rather than commonplace automation or music-generation tools. Applying the term universally dilutes the marketing power of future breakthroughs. Furthermore, Trump faces hurdles across other government branches, as he cannot stop Congress from using the original phrase, which remains codified in existing federal statutes that government agencies must uphold in court.

title: Five people shot and killed in apparent murder-suicide, Georgia police say
description: Five members of the same family have died following a suspected murder-suicide at a residence in Douglas, south Georgia. Emergency services attended the property on Friday after receiving an active shooter alert,…
fullText:
Five members of the same family have died following a suspected murder-suicide at a residence in Douglas, south Georgia. Emergency services attended the property on Friday after receiving an active shooter alert, which had been placed by one of the victims.

Upon entering the house, police discovered the bodies of four adults who had sustained fatal gunshot wounds. A fifth person was taken to a local hospital for emergency treatment, but was subsequently pronounced dead. Authorities have not yet disclosed the precise sequence of events or identified who among the household fired the shots, noting that the broader circumstances remain under formal investigation.

Law enforcement revealed that an earlier emergency call had been logged from the residence hours before the fatal gunfire took place. During that prior contact, a woman residing at the address reported to police that her husband’s smoking was killing her. Following that initial complaint, emergency medical staff conveyed the woman to a nearby medical centre.

Speaking at a media conference on Saturday, Douglas Police Chief Brannen Pruette acknowledged the deep distress the deaths have caused within the local community, appealing to the public to afford the surviving relatives privacy whilst they mourn. Police have kept further operational findings confidential as inquiries into the case proceed.

The event marks the second apparent murder-suicide in the area within a span of three months, according to Douglas City Manager Charlie Davis. Addressing the broader context of the incident, Davis highlighted the pervasive nature of domestic violence, remarking that it transcends race, religion, and geographic location. He urged residents to avoid unverified speculation surrounding the tragedy, which coincided with another lethal family shooting and suicide reported in Pennsylvania on the same day.

Reporting source: theguardian.com. AI-assisted original explainer based on the cited reporting.
